title: Add stable Tensor overloads for bitwise_and/or/left_shift/right_shift (2.14+)
body:
## Summary
- Add `torch::stable::{bitwise_and,bitwise_or,bitwise_left_shift,bitwise_right_shift}` Tensor–Tensor wrappers (gated at 2.14) via `torch_call_dispatcher`
- Document the new APIs in the stable operators docs
- Cover them in the 2.14 libtorch-agnostic extension tests (same-shape + broadcasting)

## Test plan
- [x] `python -m pytest test/cpp_extensions/test_libtorch_agnostic.py -k test_my_bitwise_ops`


cc @janeyx99
